name: Yibin

queries.query: Yibin China official cadastral parcel map GIS land registration public map service 宜宾 cadastral parcel map official
queries.result: Official Sichuan Natural Resources reporting identified Yibin's local natural-resources bureau and a Sichuan southern unified geographic-information public-service platform project; no anonymous public parcel feature endpoint was found in discovery.

queries.query: 宜宾 官方 地籍图 地块 查询 GIS 不动产 登记 地图
queries.result: The official Yibin Natural Resources and Planning Bureau site exposed a dedicated 不动产登记 section and linked the Yibin online real-estate registration portal; no safe anonymous ID-plus-geometry parcel response was exposed.

registryFoundBasis: The official Yibin Natural Resources and Planning Bureau maintains a local 不动产登记 (real-estate registration) section and links an online registration portal; this evidences local registry custody, but not open parcel-vector access.
discoveryMethod: Separate English and Simplified-Chinese first-party discovery, official Yibin bureau page review, Sichuan Natural Resources GIS-platform report review, and bounded anonymous GET checks of the official bureau and linked portal routes.
queryOutcomes: The local bureau and national/provincial natural-resources context were identified. The official bureau page exposes registration procedures/notices and links the Yibin registration portal, but the tested routes did not expose public map JavaScript/configuration, parcel-layer schema, CRS, or anonymous ID-plus-polygon output. No geometry was retained.

attempts.outcome: Found official Sichuan Natural Resources reporting on Yibin's geographic-information public-service platform project and the official Yibin bureau site; no public parcel API was found.

attempts.query: 宜宾 官方 地籍图 地块 查询 GIS 不动产 登记 地图
attempts.outcome: Found the official Yibin bureau's 不动产登记 section and its linked online registration portal; no public parcel API or safe geometry response was found.
Official Yibin Natural Resources and Planning Bureau homepage loaded; it identifies the local bureau and links the 不动产登记 section and a geographic-information platform route.

Official local real-estate registration page loaded. It exposed registration news, notices, regulations, procedures, and the linked portal http://bdc.ybdlr.gov.cn/bdc.php; no parcel service schema or geometry endpoint was exposed.
Bounded anonymous request did not return a usable response before timeout; no login was attempted, no credentials or tokens were used, and no absence inference was made.
The geographic-information platform link from the official bureau page did not return a usable response within the bounded request; no TLS bypass or authentication was attempted.

Official Sichuan Natural Resources report states that Yibin and provincial agencies planned a unified geographic-information public-service platform and natural-resources 3D map; it is project/custodian evidence, not a parcel feature response.

sourceAssessment.localCustodian: Yibin Natural Resources and Planning Bureau, including its local 不动产登记 section; the Sichuan Natural Resources report identifies the former Yibin land-resources bureau and local information center as participants in the public-platform work.
sourceAssessment.publicService: No anonymously usable public parcel feature service was verified. The official bureau links an online real-estate registration portal and a geographic-information platform route, but neither yielded public parcel schema or ID-plus-polygon data in the bounded checks.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel identifier if a future official feature response exposes one
non-sensitive service schema and CRS metadata
scopeLimits: Local registry custody is evidenced, but citywide parcel coverage is not established.
The official GIS-platform report describes an institutional project and does not provide an open parcel-vector download or feature response.
The linked portal/platform timeouts and unusable responses are availability findings, not evidence of cadastral absence.
The exact WUP point was preserved and not used to force a parcel hit; no exact-point hit test was performed against a verified parcel endpoint.
No full native parcel geometry with a safe native identity was obtained, so no GeoJSON sample is included.
No unsafe fields were requested or retained.
Research completion does not constitute source integration, adapter admission, or runtime qualification.
uncertainty: Yibin local registry custody and a documented public-platform initiative are established, but the current anonymous parcel service route, native identity fields, CRS, geometry access, and citywide completeness remain unresolved.
pointBasis: Immutable WUP queue point; retained exactly and not shifted to seek a parcel hit.
